mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), reducing isoniazid metabolism and potentially increasing hepatotoxicity risk; isoniazid may also inhibit nafcillin metabolism to a lesser degree.
action: Monitor liver function tests closely, ensure adequate isoniazid dosing is maintained, and watch for signs of isoniazid toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available.
